description: Medicare IRMAA band calculator: takes a tax filing status, the look-back-year adjusted gross income and tax-exempt interest, and the Medicare enrollment facts, and returns MAGI, the IRMAA band, the 2026 Part B total monthly premium and Part D income-related monthly adjustment amount, the annualised per-enrollee and household amounts, the headroom in dollars before the next cliff, the annual cost of crossing it, and the effect of additional income under consideration. All money is integer USD cents; the node reads no clock and performs no network or text-encoding work, so compute(pp) is a pure function of its input. Band edges follow the CMS semantics that every threshold except the last is exclusive and the last is inclusive. Premium tables are inputs with named 2026 CMS literal defaults. Refuses malformed input, unknown filing status, non-increasing threshold ladders and premium tables shorter than the band count with named reasons.
deferred_reason: New gpu:false node, art-762-irmaa-bracket-calculator, built 2026-10-20 (APEX-PORT-150-LAND-1). Pure integer-cents arithmetic over fixed 2026 CMS literal tables (threshold sweeps, sums, products, one explicit round-half-away-from-zero integer division) with no clock, randomness, text encoding or network in compute(); expected FAST on GPU-CYCLE-PREFLIGHT-1 static pre-screen. standards_basis is not_applicable: the node implements CMS 2026 IRMAA parameters as published data (CITES.md C1/C2), not a machine-checkable clause of a standard; DIFFERS.md D-1..D-5 record every divergence from the Apex #150 page where the official CMS figure wins.
